Simulate historical dynamics for a directory of operating models

Source: R/simulate_oms.R
Simulate_OM_Dir.Rd

Recursively finds all `.om` files under `om_dir` (as saved by [MSEtool::Save()], e.g. via [Import_OM_Grid()]), runs [MSEtool::Simulate()] on each, and saves the resulting `Hist` object under `hist_dir`.

Usage

Simulate_OM_Dir(om_dir, hist_dir, recursive = TRUE)

Arguments

om_dir

Character. Directory to search for `.om` files.

hist_dir

Character. Directory to save `.hist` files to; created (including subdirectories) if necessary.

recursive

Logical. If `TRUE` (default), searches subdirectories of `om_dir` as well.

Value

Invisibly, a character vector of the saved `.hist` file paths.

Details

The directory structure of `om_dir` is mirrored under `hist_dir`, so e.g. `om_dir/Reference/G_25-M_25.om` is saved to `hist_dir/Reference/G_25-M_25.hist`.
